provenance.producer: NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies (GISS) — original producer; values here come via a secondary tracker
provenance.dataset: GISTEMP v4 Land-Ocean Temperature Index (LOTI), global monthly mean anomalies, Oct 2025 – Sep 2026
provenance.periodA: 1951–1980 reference baseline (0.00 °C by definition; a reference line, not a measured series)
provenance.periodB: 2025-10 through 2026-09, monthly global land-ocean surface temperature anomalies
provenance.units: °C anomaly relative to the corresponding 1951–1980 monthly mean

verification.note: Not compared with the official GISTEMP CSV. Official file: https://data.giss.nasa.gov/gistemp/tabledata_v4/GLB.Ts+dSST.csv

provenance.mirrorNote: Secondary tracker the values were copied from (snapshot page last copied 2026-10-16 per the supplier). Not an official NASA source.

metadata.sourceProduct: GISTEMP v4 LOTI, monthly global mean
metadata.reasonForEmptyPoints: Global time series, not geolocated observations; no geographic points may be drawn.
metadata.verificationStatus: PROVISIONAL: not diff-checked against the official CSV (official site unreachable from the build environment).
